_comment: LOCAL e5 A/B TEST CONFIG — 2026-08-25. Purpose: index eShopOnWeb with the LOCAL ONNX stack (e5-large-v2 1024-dim + bge-reranker-v2-m3) so the six-question battery can be run against it and compared with the hosted bge-code-v1 + Qwen3-Reranker-4B results. Copy this file to config.json next to the Server exe AND the Indexer exe.
_comment_sql: SQL Server 2025, default instance. Trusted_Connection uses your Windows login.
_comment_models: ABSOLUTE paths — relative ones resolve against the working directory, not the exe folder. JSON requires each backslash doubled; Windows collapses the doubles, so these paste into Explorer as-is. EmbeddingDimension MUST be 1024 for e5-large-v2 — the 1536 default matches the hosted bge-code-v1 and would build the DDL, DiskANN index and SearchCode proc at the wrong width.
_comment_rerankerpool: 30 is the production default. 10 for this test: the cross-encoder scores every candidate on CPU and we are measuring rank-1 correctness, not pool depth. Raise back to 30 if comparing recall.
_comment_huggingface: DELIBERATELY BLANK. The Server prefers Hugging Face whenever these are set, which would embed queries with bge-code-v1 (1536-dim) against an index built with e5 (1024-dim). Every result would be garbage.
_comment_embedservice: Blanked so nothing can silently fall through to the hosted Azure endpoint mid-index. Local ONNX only.
_comment_corpus: Same corpus as the live hosted demo (254 files / 605 chunks) — this is what makes the two runs comparable. Do not change it.
_comment_maxvectordistance: KEEP AT 2.0. The cut is applied INSIDE VECTOR_SEARCH, so a value below the model's real NL-to-code distance floor empties the vector leg silently and search degrades to full-text with no error. 2.0 disables the cut. Do not tighten without re-measuring for e5.
